This catalogue is the evidence layer behind the history. Each record identifies what a source is, whether a copy has actually been read, and how it is being used.

The collection includes:

- contemporary or near-contemporary records that have been inspected, including Hansard, Haw's 1989 overview, and the 1995 HEU *Guardian*
- bibliographic and abstract records that confirm a work existed without providing its full text
- later official, organizational and journalistic accounts used with their date and perspective made explicit
- the 2008 [CSIL Program Review Synthesis Report](2008-program-review-synthesis.qmd), inspected from an Internet Archive Microlog fiche
- four remaining [wanted sources](../research/wanted-sources.qmd): the Creekview evaluation, *Keys on Freedom*, ECPM manual(s), and original ministry CSIL pilot/design records
- one clearly labelled [example / template record](example-template-source-record.qmd), which is not a research item

A catalogue entry is not, by itself, proof that the original document has been read. Check **Availability**, **Verification**, and the annotation on the source page before relying on a claim.

The metadata model is documented in [source metadata](../docs/source-metadata.qmd), [controlled vocabularies](../docs/vocabularies.qmd), and [evidence statuses](../docs/evidence-status.qmd).

The narrative chapters using these records are [Creekview](../history/creekview.qmd), [ECPM](../history/ecpm.qmd), [CSIL design and pilot](../history/csil-pilot.qmd), and [later evolution](../history/evolution.qmd). The [History overview](../history/index.qmd#state-of-the-evidence) summarizes what the current evidence does and does not establish.
